Aggregation operator from grid cells to observed cells

Source: R/data-regroup.R
mt_operator.Rd

A sparse matrix with one row per observed cell of one stratum and one column per grid cell (age varies fastest), with entry 1 where the grid cell lies inside the observed cell. It links latent quantities on the grid to what is observed, for example in the penalized composite link model.

Usage

mt_operator(data, measure, stratum)

Arguments

data

An mt_data object.

measure

Measure name.

stratum

Stratum id.

Value

A dgCMatrix. Attribute rows gives the observed cells.

Examples

x <- mt_example()
C <- mt_operator(x, "deaths", 1)
dim(C)
#> [1]  390 2130
